description: Tavia Galonski is honored to serve Summit County residents as Clerk of Courts and humbled to be a candidate for Judge of the 9th District Court of Appeals. Comprised of two Divisions - Legal and Title - the Clerk's Office maintains records for the Summit County Common Pleas Court (General Division), the Summit County Domestic Relations Court, and the Ninth District Court of Appeals, as well as issuing Certificates of Title for watercraft and motor vehicles.
